output.scope_note: The paper is mainly an agent-framework paper, but it reports computed room-temperature Li-ion conductivities for two halide solid-state electrolyte candidates (LiErCl4, LiErBr4), so it qualifies.

records.measurement_method: MLIP (UMA-s-1p2-omat) molecular dynamics with diffusion analysis
records.evidence_quote: LiErCl4 and LiErBr4, which are thermodynamically stable according to the DFTconstructed convex hull phase diagram and exhibit high predicted conductivities of 63.4 and 4.5 mS cm−1
records.evidence_location: Results, section B (Generative design of Li-ion solid conductor)
records.notes: Room-temperature conductivity is extrapolated from multi-temperature MD, not measured. The paper states these are screening estimates rather than converged values. Activation energy 0.14 eV is from the same sentence (paired 'respectively' with LiErBr4).
